Messages.Author: Quicksilver
Messages.Body:
If Rotschrech is played in a combat where one of the minions strikes
with an untap affect (as per superior Majesty) does the minion get to
untap? Will Catatonic Fear still deal damage at the end of the round?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No and no (assuming Rotschreck is played before strike resolution,
which is almost certainly the case).
